newsitem.title: USA: Alliance "eager" to answer SEC inquiry.
newsitem.headline: Alliance "eager" to answer SEC inquiry.

text.p: Alliance Industries said it was eager to answer any questions and provide documents to satisfy a Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) inquiry.
The SEC Tuesday said it was suspending Alliance trading for 10 days due to questions raised about the company's Internet home page.
The company also said it disputed the contention that there was a lack of adequate and accurate information about its financial projections on its Internet home page.

"Our earnings model, which we have published in our promotional materials and on the Internet, is based on extremely accurate, yet conservative projections," Donald Baillargeon, vice president of corporate development, said in a statement.
